text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 887 February 3, 1976
AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 183 REQUIRING THE MANDATORY REGISTRATION
OF AFP RESERVISTS ANNUALLY TO ONCE EVERY THREE YEARS BEGINNING 1976.
By virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of
the Philippines, and pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972; and General Order No. 1,
dated September 22, 1972, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do hereby amend
Presidential Decree No. 183, issued on May 6, 1973, by requiring the mandatory registration of all AFP
reservists only once every three years beginning 1976 instead of annually, for the purpose of updating their
records in the AFP.
This Decree shall take immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
